purpose: Reject an obviously under-provisioned full-resolution RCP batch before creating cloud rows or jobs.

implementation.estimate: persistent float32 XYZ/RGB arrays and preview per station + one sequential float64 XYZ/RGB raw stream + 10% margin + configured free-space reserve
implementation.unknown_or_missing_manifest_counts: skip estimate and retain authoritative per-chunk streaming disk guard

live_isolated_api.database: temporary isolated test database under TEMP

additional_cases: Full-resolution multi-node RCP is rejected before creating clouds/jobs when disk is insufficient.
Full-resolution single-node RCP is rejected before creating cloud/job rows when disk is insufficient.

acceptance: This prevents a full RCP import from beginning when the manifest-based estimate exceeds available disk and confirms there are no partial cloud/job writes. The estimate is conservative but based on manifest metadata; native source counts can differ, and the existing per-chunk disk guard remains authoritative. Stage 2 remains open for full-volume RCP/ReCap round-trip, native full-resolution cancellation/restart, resource envelope, and the 244259-point declaration discrepancy. The refreshed main project API on port 8000 was also checked against the real RCP: HTTP 507 before cloud/job writes, with the project database unchanged; its served UI asset manifest matches the current production build.
